[[Thul Boulderrain]] is a [[Giant]] [[ranger]] [[boss]] that can [[spawn]] in [[Snake Dance]].

==Locations==
*[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Snake Dance}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Frozen Soil}}
*{{skill icon|Punishing Shot}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}
*{{monster skill icon|Giant Stomp}} 

==Items dropped==
*[[Giant Slayers Hammer]]
*[[Giant's Boots]]
*[[Huge Jawbone]]
*[[Tundra Giant's Bracer]]

==Notes==
*Does not always spawn.  To avoid starting from the beginning you can exit to [[Dreadnought's Drift]] then [[zone]] back to respawn bosses.
*Shares the same spawn locations with [[Kor Stonewrath]].

{{bug|Sometimes his death animation is repeated infinitely.}}
